credits.title: A Girl Unknown
credits.overview: A Chinese girl is passed between three families from the age of 6 to 18, receiving each time a new name and identity. As she searches for belonging and the possibility of love, she has to navigate between the weight of her past and the uncertainty of her future, until she finds her own way.

credits.title: Suzhou Quartet
credits.overview: In the plum rain season, within an ancient town south of the Yangtze River, each of them bears their own troubles, their thoughts trapped in time. On a stormy night, four people meet by chance in a small noodle shop, only to find they are long-lost acquaintances.

credits.title: She's Got No Name
credits.overview: A bizarre case caused thousands of waves. There are different opinions on the truth. When the whole story of the case was gradually restored like pieces of a puzzle, people realized that the truth was not that important anymore.

credits.title: All in All 4 You
credits.overview: A group of students trained in the special school for the art college entrance examination.

credits.title: Blind Date, Clear Night
credits.overview: The story of the relationship of a 50-year-old migrant worker and the 20-year-old university student.

credits.title: The Western Trunk Line
credits.overview: Authentic and subtly-written coming-of-age story set against the end of the dark 1970s. A dominant mother, a taciturn father, an elder brother who won’t shape up and the little brother who won’t take sides. Then a beautiful girl comes to live across the road from distant Beijing. (IFFR.com)
